bias.label: Neutral: slipped under 4,135, holding 4,106 before CPI

event: US October CPI, today Tue 10 Nov 15:30 SAST. US PPI Fri 13 Nov 15:30 SAST.

bullets.title: Slipping into Europe
bullets.text: Spot gold was about 4,116 at 07:21 SAST, down about 24 (0.6%) on the day, after a high of 4,147 and a low of 4,107 (Kitco).

bullets.title: 4,135 lost
bullets.text: Price fell back under the 4,130-4,135 area it was testing at 03:30, so that area is now resistance, not support (Kitco).

bullets.title: Dollar flat
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 101.65, roughly flat today, so the dollar is not the main driver this morning (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Hike odds high
bullets.text: Markets price about 82-84% odds of a December Fed hike and the US 10-year yield is near 4.87-4.88%, which keeps a lid on gold (Trading Economics, Mitrade).

bullets.title: Key zones
bullets.text: Mitrade lists support at 4,074-4,082 and resistance at 4,145-4,157, which frame today's plans.

bullets.title: CPI decides today
bullets.text: October CPI lands at 15:30 SAST; a hot number can push gold toward 4,074, a soft one can reopen 4,145-4,157 and above (Mitrade).
